applicability: Applies to exact integer evaluation of uniformly nested affine expressions parameterized by multiplier, addend, seed, and depth. Rejects non-integer, missing, extra, negative-depth, or excessively large inputs. Not suitable for symbolic simplification, non-uniform nesting, or non-integer parameters.
description: Evaluate a nested expression of the form a*(b + a*(b + ... a*(b + c)...)) with n layers. Start from the innermost seed c and repeatedly apply x -> a*(b + x) exactly n times using Python integers. Inputs are validated: all four parameters must be present, integers (booleans rejected), depth nonnegative and bounded, and magnitudes bounded to keep computation deterministic and resource-safe. The result is returned as a decimal string. Uncertainty: the only ambiguity is the interpretation of nesting depth, which here is the number of times the layer a*(b+...) is applied around the seed.
